meta.title: One Move
meta.instructions: White to move: find the checkmate. Tap a piece, then its square, or drag it there. Two misses and the answer is shown.

do.if: event.mate or (event.from == sol_from() and event.to == sol_to())

else.to: if event.check then event.name + ': check, but the king escapes.' else event.name + ' isn’t check.'

children.color: = if phase == 'right' then $accent else if phase == 'wrong' then $danger_ink else $ink

whys: Re8: the king’s own pawns block every escape square.
Qxf7: the bishop guards the queen, so the king can’t take her.
Nf7: walled in by its own rook and pawns, the king can’t move.
Rh7: the knight guards the rook and covers g8.
Qg7: the bishop on f6 guards the queen.
Rh8: the other rook holds the 7th rank.
Qxh7: the knight guards the queen and the king is boxed in.
Rd8: the king’s own pawns wall off its escape squares.
e8=Q: the new queen mates along the back rank.
